morphology.pattern_note: di- 是被动前缀，与 timpa 连写，不改变词根首辅音 t。输入把 ditimpa 标为词根有误；其词根为 timpa。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=timpa)

senses.zh_definition: 被落下的物体砸中、压住；受到落下之物的冲击。
senses.en_definition: To be struck or crushed by something falling onto one.
senses.ms_definition: Dikenai atau dihempap oleh sesuatu yang jatuh menindih.
senses.nuances: 是 menimpa 的被动形式，句子主语为承受落物冲击的人或物。不一定表示严重压伤；具体后果由语境说明。

collocations.en: be struck by a falling tree
be hit by a falling rock

senses.zh_definition: 遭受灾难、不幸、疾病或其他不利事件。
senses.en_definition: To be afflicted by illness, disaster, or misfortune.
senses.ms_definition: Terkena atau mengalami sesuatu yang mendatangkan kesusahan, seperti penyakit, bencana atau kemalangan.
senses.nuances: 常用于不幸事件，语气比普通 mengalami 更突出受害或受苦。不宜用来中性表达获得奖项等好事。释义依据 DBP 的 timpa 词族整理。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Seorang penunggang motosikal cedera selepas ditimpa dahan pokok yang patah ketika ribut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 一名摩托车骑士在暴风雨中被折断落下的树枝砸伤。
dual_scenarios.en: A motorcyclist was injured after being struck by a tree branch that broke off during the storm.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku baru tahu keluarga dia ditimpa musibah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya baru mengetahui bahawa keluarganya ditimpa musibah.
dual_scenarios.en: I’ve just heard that something terrible happened to his family.
spoken_features: baru tahu 是自然口语表达
keluarga dia 对应较书面的 keluarganya
ditimpa musibah 在口语中仍保留较郑重的语气

messages.ms_spoken: Aku baru tahu keluarga dia ditimpa musibah.
messages.ms_standard: Saya baru mengetahui bahawa keluarganya ditimpa musibah.
messages.en: I’ve just heard that something terrible happened to his family.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kesian dia. Kalau dia nak bantuan, kita tolonglah apa yang boleh.
messages.ms_standard: Kasihan dia. Jika dia memerlukan bantuan, marilah kita membantunya sedaya upaya.
messages.zh: 真替他难过。他要是需要帮忙，我们能帮就帮吧。
messages.en: That’s awful for him. If he needs help, let’s do what we can.

etymology.historical_story: The image behind timpa is something falling onto another thing. Malay also uses that image for illness and misfortune. The traditional saying sudah jatuh ditimpa tangga pictures someone falling and then being struck by a ladder: one setback followed by another. It makes the connection between physical impact and compounded suffering especially memorable. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=timpa)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 timpa 想成重物“砰”地落下；di- 把视角转向承受者，所以 ditimpa 就是“被砸中”，再引申为“遭受”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈别人 ditimpa musibah 时，宜表达关怀并尊重隐私。可说 Semoga dipermudahkan segala urusan，祝愿对方诸事顺利。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于事故报道、慰问和叙述困境。面对刚遭遇不幸的人，不宜用 sudah jatuh ditimpa tangga 打趣，也不要把灾祸说成对方应受的惩罚。
